snippet.title: BRUSHHAMMER MINIATURE PAINTER - WISHLIST - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: BrushHammer is a mixed-reality game that lets you live the miniature painting hobby without spilling paint on your desk! Pick from a huge collection of minis, kitbash them with different parts and accessories, and paint them using awesome tools like spray cans, airbrushes, shading brushes, decals, and shiny coatings.  Show off your masterpiece in your space, send pics to friends, and climb from total newbie to legendary painter in Career Mode.  Complete commissions, impress picky judges, and spend your hard-earned points in the hobby shop on new tools, accessories, and upgrades for your creative setup. BrushHammer Miniature Painter is now available to wishlist on the Meta store! For more info players can sign up for our Newsletter to know when our Open Beta goes live, and we've got a Discord too. All info is available on https://brushhammergame.com/
